    // The signed distance from a point to the line with the given unit normal at
    // signed offset from the origin — the planar counterpart of DistanceToPlane,
    // and the boundary of a half-plane. Exact. Precondition: normal has unit
    // length.
    DistanceToLine(p: Point2D, normal: Vector2D, offset: Number): Number
        => p.PositionVector.Dot(normal) + offset;
